# Webllope

> Webllope is a web design studio in Murcia (Spain) that builds fast, SEO-ready websites and online stores for small businesses and freelancers, with close one-to-one service, fixed transparent quotes and no mandatory monthly fees.

Location: Plaza Circular, 30008 Murcia, Spain · Phone/WhatsApp: +34 722 10 99 24 · Email: info@webllope.es
Languages: Spanish (primary), English.

## Core capabilities

- Professional website design and development (WordPress, Astro, React), from €350
- Online store design (WooCommerce, PrestaShop, Shopify)
- Local SEO and web positioning in Murcia
- Social media management
- Logo and brand design
- 3D animation for businesses
